def transform(grid):
    holes = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, value in enumerate(row) if value == 0]
    if not holes:
        return []
    r0 = min(r for r, c in holes)
    r1 = max(r for r, c in holes)
    c0 = min(c for r, c in holes)
    c1 = max(c for r, c in holes)
    return [[grid[len(grid) - 1 - r][len(grid[0]) - 1 - c]
             for c in range(c0, c1 + 1)]
            for r in range(r0, r1 + 1)]
